english.note: This is the all-purpose choice before a noun when something cannot be controlled, especially an urge, impulse, or reaction.

exampleSentences.english: I have an uncontrollable urge to eat snacks.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我有控制唔到嘅衝動，成日想食零食。
